text: {"name": "init_hw_descriptor_tables", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Initializes two fixed-size tables of 64-byte descriptor entries by writing common tag/status/flash-size fields and a byte-swapped magic word, with the second table leaving trailing magic/length fields zero.", "subsystem": "hal", "var_renames": {"v0": "first_table_cur", "v4": "first_table_end", "v1": "entry_tag", "v2": "entry_config", "v3": "magic_word_src", "v5": "flash_size", "v6": "magic_word", "v7": "second_table_cur", "v8": "second_entry_tag", "v9": "second_entry_config", "v10": "magic_word_src2", "v11": "second_table_end", "v13": "magic_raw", "v14": "magic_raw", "result": "flash_size_ret"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "descriptor entry tag/control word"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "status/command word formed from IRQ/hardware status result shifted left by 14"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "flash size or boot parameter"}, {"offset": 16, "meaning": "descriptor configuration constant"}, {"offset": 36, "meaning": "byte-swapped magic/version word"}, {"offset": 40, "meaning": "repeated magic/version word or zero"}, {"offset": 44, "meaning": "repeated magic/version word or zero"}, {"offset": 48, "meaning": "repeated magic/version word or zero"}, {"offset": 52, "meaning": "small constant/length field (0x2200) or zero"}, {"offset": 56, "meaning": "large constant/length field (0x3F0000)"}]}
